_comment: No B-roll stinger splices. The reel already carries a lot inside its own frames -- the five-city behind-subject snap sequence, a hero slam, three badges, two marker highlights and a real cruise photo card -- and the two longest segments are the ones doing that work, so cutting away from her to a motion-graphic stinger would interrupt exactly the beats that need to land. All four cuts get an energetic brand wipe instead, each a different style from its neighbours so a 37s reel never repeats a transition back to back.
